title: A stream a delivery set still running at the cut hands its cascade afterwards is closed unread, and nothing waits for its end
notes: The message's delivery set asks the agent, which answers with a stream, and delivers to ws, which fails, so the set records its targets' outcomes on its event (§5.13); a set hands its cascade its streams only once that record is written. The fault holds the record at recording once it is written: every target has answered, and the set, still running, has not handed over the agent's stream. The cut lands there: none of the cascade's turns is running, and it returns at once. Once the record goes on, the set hands the cut cascade the stream before its AFTER_BROADCAST hook reaches after-set: the stream is closed unread (turn_ends: close; the model is asked nothing) and not joined: the handle's wait returns while the agent's turn still owes its end, held at end-owed, which a joined close would wait for past every bound (cancel_ms 20 s). Whether the owner reads that end once it comes is not asserted. A stream handed before the cut, closed and joined, is RK-10.1-103's.
